description: HTTP client SSL test scenarios with Virtual Threads for Java 21

testCategories.name: TLS Protocol Version Tests
testCategories.description: Tests for different TLS protocol versions with Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: TLS 1.3 Preferred Protocol
scenarios.description: Verify that TLS 1.3 is preferred when available with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using TLS 1.3 protocol

scenarios.name: TLS 1.2 Fallback Protocol
scenarios.description: Verify fallback to TLS 1.2 when TLS 1.3 is not available with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using TLS 1.2 protocol when TLS 1.3 is not available

scenarios.name: TLS Protocol Enforcement
scenarios.description: Verify that only specified TLS protocols are used with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using only TLS 1.2, rejecting connections with older protocols

scenarios.name: TLS Protocol Negotiation
scenarios.description: Verify protocol negotiation behavior with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using server's preferred protocol (TLS 1.2) even when client supports TLS 1.3

testCategories.name: Cipher Suite Tests
testCategories.description: Tests for different cipher suites with Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: Forward Secrecy Cipher Suites
scenarios.description: Verify that cipher suites with forward secrecy are preferred with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using a cipher suite with forward secrecy

scenarios.name: TLS 1.2 Cipher Suites
scenarios.description: Verify TLS 1.2 cipher suite selection with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using a TLS 1.2 cipher suite with forward secrecy

scenarios.name: Cipher Suite Order Preference
scenarios.description: Verify that server's cipher suite order is respected with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using server's preferred cipher suite

scenarios.name: Diffie-Hellman Key Size
scenarios.description: Verify that 2048-bit DH key size is used with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established using 2048-bit DH key size

testCategories.name: Authentication Tests
testCategories.description: Tests for different authentication mechanisms with Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: Standard TLS Authentication
scenarios.description: Verify standard TLS authentication with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established with server authentication only

scenarios.name: Mutual TLS Authentication
scenarios.description: Verify mutual TLS authentication with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection established with mutual authentication

scenarios.name: Certificate Validation
scenarios.description: Verify certificate validation with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection rejected due to invalid certificate

scenarios.name: Hostname Verification
scenarios.description: Verify hostname verification with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection rejected due to hostname verification failure

testCategories.name: Connection Pooling Tests
testCategories.description: Tests for connection pooling with Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: Connection Reuse

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connections are reused efficiently with Virtual Threads

scenarios.name: Connection Eviction
scenarios.description: Verify connection eviction with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Idle connections are evicted after timeout

scenarios.name: Connection Validation
scenarios.description: Verify connection validation with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connections are validated after inactivity period

scenarios.name: Connection Limit
scenarios.description: Verify connection limit behavior with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Connection limits are respected with Virtual Threads

scenarios.expectedOutcome: SSL handshake operations don't cause thread pinning

scenarios.name: SSL I/O Pinning

scenarios.expectedOutcome: SSL I/O operations don't cause thread pinning

scenarios.name: SSL Session Cache Pinning
scenarios.description: Verify that SSL session cache operations don't cause thread pinning with Virtual Threads
scenarios.expectedOutcome: SSL session cache operations don't cause thread pinning

scenarios.name: Synchronized Block Pinning
scenarios.description: Verify that synchronized blocks in SSL code cause thread pinning with Virtual Threads
